name: ns_proofsearch_finite_stencil_full_closure
rubric_version_reason: Successor after Phase 5DV: square-law-only bridges are blocked, but finite-stencil/correlated full nonlinear closure remains live.
description: Focused theorem-search substrate for constructing or excluding a non-tautological finite-stencil/correlated Navier-Stokes certificate that closes the full nonlinear remainder.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier theorem-search over the finite-stencil full-closure bridge.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by full nonlinear closure gates, non-tautology, and proof-cost reranking.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The exact projection square law blocks square-law-only and tail-reducible bridges, but moving finite-stencil/correlated certificates remain live. Reward only a non-tautological certificate or no-go theorem that pays the full nonlinear Navier-Stokes remainder: high-low, high-high, Euclidean pressure/Leray, exterior stretching, signed profit, and residual transfer. Penalize phase-fitting, observed-margin definitions, metric-kernel pressure substitution, finite-to-infinite supremum induction, weak-solution overclaims, stochastic derandomization handwaves, and unbounded computation.

dimensions.name: Certificate Independence
dimensions.description: Is the finite-stencil/correlated certificate defined independently of residual cancellation, profit dominance, or observed gain/loss?

dimensions.name: Escape Survival
dimensions.description: Does the certificate remain nontrivial on escaping high-frequency active-shell profiles?

dimensions.name: High-Low Closure
dimensions.description: Does it pay the high-low paraproduct/exterior transport burden?

dimensions.name: High-High Closure
dimensions.description: Does it pay high-high cascade transfer rather than hiding it in a tail term?

dimensions.name: Pressure And Leray Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it use the Euclidean pressure/Leray operator correctly and avoid metric-kernel substitution?

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Transfer
dimensions.description: Does it report projected NSE residual or defect alongside signed profit and give a real transfer condition?

dimensions.name: Non-Tail Domination
dimensions.description: Does it avoid reducing the decisive margin to the summable square-law tail?

dimensions.name: Cycle Or Critical-Norm Relevance
dimensions.description: Does it connect the closure ledger to a danger-reset-return cycle, LP critical norm, or smooth-data realization?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, exact falsifier, CAS/Lean-facing object list, or decisive proof-cost reranking?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Resource Safety
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay overclaim and keep proposed audits bounded, sparse, symbolic, or proof-facing?

dimensions.name: Ledger Non-Tautology
dimensions.description: HARD GATE. Candidate code must not set the audited margin equal to tau_B and then assert it is <= tau_B. High scores require explicit ledger terms or a symbolic class-collapse theorem.

criteria.Certificate_Independence: Full credit requires an independent rule for the certificate before residual/profit evaluation; score zero for phase-fitting or observed-margin definitions.
criteria.Escape_Survival: Full credit requires nontriviality on active-shell escaping profiles or a proof that such survival is impossible for the stated class.
criteria.High_Low_Closure: Full credit requires explicit high-low paraproduct/exterior transport control or a falsifier showing the class fails there.
criteria.High_High_Closure: Full credit requires explicit high-high/cascade transfer control or a falsifier showing the class fails there.
criteria.Pressure_And_Leray_Discipline: Full credit requires Euclidean pressure/Leray treatment and rejects metric-kernel substitution.
criteria.Residual_Defect_Transfer: Full credit requires residual/defect and signed profit to be reported together with a transfer condition.
criteria.Non_Tail_Domination: Full credit requires the decisive margin not be bounded by sum_{B>=K}(1-R_B^2).
criteria.Cycle_Or_Critical_Norm_Relevance: Full credit requires a bridge to cycle margin, critical norm, or smooth-data realization rather than a purely kinematic certificate.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a usable theorem/falsifier packet or decisive route reranking.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Resource_Safety: Reject unsupported regularity/blowup claims and unbounded dense computation proposals.
criteria.Ledger_Non_Tautology: Score at most 60 if the code uses I_model=tau_B as the sole margin audit. Full credit requires explicit high-low/high-high/pressure/exterior/profit/residual ledger terms or a proof that the enumerated certificate class symbolically collapses to tau_B.

success_criteria: A positive non-tautological finite-stencil/correlated certificate satisfying the full nonlinear closure ledger.
A no-go theorem proving a stated finite-stencil/correlated class collapses to square-law-tail domination or fails a closure gate.
A bounded exact Fourier/CAS falsifier that kills a concrete class and names the next theorem target.
failure_modes: Choosing phases, amplitudes, stencils, cycle widths, dwell times, or loss variables from the target conclusion.
Inferring a uniform infinite-dimensional margin from R_B<1 despite sup_B R_B=1.
Treating stencil survival as full nonlinear closure.
Setting margin = tau_B and treating margin <= tau_B as an independent finite-stencil ledger audit.
Ignoring high-low, high-high, pressure/Leray, exterior stretching, or residual-defect transfer.
Substituting a metric kernel for the Euclidean pressure Hessian.
Treating convex-integration weak nonuniqueness as a Clay blowup route.
Using stochastic regularization without a deterministic derandomization theorem.
Replacing theorem-facing discrimination with large dense Fourier jobs, unbounded Lean builds, or the crashed exponential metric transport obstruction.
